purpose: Review one finite Campaign115 catalog against the complete v84 mechanism frontier and select at most one point-in-time source mechanism before any Campaign115 provider row, candidate value, comparator value, daily price, or forward return is read.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: tushare_official_limit_up_queue_persistence
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: For each completed signal session, use the official limit-event roster to distinguish a still-closed upper-limit event and measure how early its final seal occurred after penalizing repeated board openings.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The official event state, final seal time, and board-opening count are unavailable in aggregate minute or daily OHLCV and cannot be reconstructed from the old limit-like close proxy. The mechanism is a point-in-time queue-persistence state, not another price-path transform or terminal-source repair. Selection does not establish entitlement, historical coverage, uniqueness, tradability, or predictive value.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: tushare_limit_up_seal_amount_ratio
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: Normalize the closing seal-order amount by a float or turnover denominator.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Choosing among seal amount, float market value, turnover, transaction amount, and provider ratios creates a denominator sweep. Campaign115 freezes the lower-dimensional time-and-reopening state instead.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: tushare_limit_event_signed_up_down_state
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: Assign positive values to upper-limit rows and negative values to lower-limit or broken-board rows.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Mixing continuation, distress, and failed-breakout mechanisms would introduce an arbitrary signed category mapping and would largely restate the exposed daily limit-like event branch.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: tushare_limit_up_first_seal_earliness
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: Use only the first seal time.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: First seal time ignores subsequent breaks and can rate a repeatedly opened queue as durable. It is an alternate formula inside the selected queue-persistence mechanism and is frozen out before values.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: official_exchange_information_disclosure_grade_local_retry
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: Retry Campaign114 discovery with a different local scraper or page parser.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign114 is permanently terminal after premature source-row exposure. Changing discovery transport or parser would be a forbidden repair.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: full_numeric_library_regularized_or_nonlinear_model
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_state: Fit another regularized, tree, or nonlinear model over the 134 numeric comparators.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign102, Campaign103, Campaign111, Campaign112, and Campaign114 already close complete-library refit and architecture substitutions. Another model is not a new information channel.

next_stage: Freeze a complete semantic-overlap audit and an exact Tushare limit_list_d source contract, including one formula, direction, event/non-event semantics, accepted time grid, row-ceiling rule, one-shot entitlement probe, 2019-2023 development-only source boundary, and fail-closed stop rules before any provider call.
